annotations.title: Check a site's robots.txt for AI crawlers

description: Read a website's public robots.txt now and report, for each major AI crawler and assistant (OpenAI, Anthropic, Perplexity, Google, Apple, Amazon, Meta, Common Crawl, ByteDance) and for Googlebot and Bingbot, whether its home page and product pages are allowed, partly blocked or blocked. Compares the result with the fashion benchmark. Reads one file; does not crawl the site.
name: check_ai_crawler_access
title: Check a site's robots.txt for AI crawlers
